title: Tech Note: Customization of the Data Grid
author: Tim Penner, Technical Support Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: This note is a hands-on, video-accompanied walkthrough of customizing the 4D Ajax Framework's Data Grid object via its JavaScript DataWindow API — hiding/showing toolbars and columns, setting column widths, and configuring tab-driven layouts using Dynamic or Template Queries. It is a concrete example of the 2007-era 'rich internet application' techniques (custom HTML pages driving a data grid via a proprietary JS client library) that were common before modern JS frameworks; the entire underlying 4D Ajax Framework and Data Grid API it documents have since been discontinued along with 4D Web 2.0 Pack.
related_updates: 4D Web 2.0 Pack and the 4D Ajax Framework (including its Data Grid/DataWindow objects) have been discontinued
Current 4D web development relies on 4D's built-in Web Server and Qodly Studio component tooling rather than 4DAF-specific JavaScript APIs
The referenced daxipedia.4d.com wiki and 4dweb20pack demo downloads are no longer current 4D resources
